build_pca_model: build a PCA model using _BasePCA to reduce dimensionality of high-dimensional data
test_get_covariance: test the _BasePCA.get_covariance method to compute data covariance with the generative model
test_get_precision: test the _BasePCA.get_precision method to compute data precision matrix using matrix inversion lemma
run_transform: run the _BasePCA.transform method to project data onto the first principal components
refactor_inverse_transform: refactor the _BasePCA.inverse_transform method to reverse whitening and recover original data
